Name: Bulbasaur
Pokedex Flavor Text: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this POKéMON.

Name: Ivysaur
Pokedex Flavor Text: When the bulb on its back grows large, it appears to lose the ability to stand on its hind legs.

Name: Venusaur
Pokedex Flavor Text: The plant blooms when it is absorbing solar energy. It stays on the move to seek sunlight.

Name: Charmander
Pokedex Flavor Text: Obviously prefers hot places. When it rains, steam is said to spout from the tip of its tail.

Name: Charmeleon
Pokedex Flavor Text: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

Name: Charizard
Pokedex Flavor Text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to cause forest fires unintentionally.

Name: Squirtle
Pokedex Flavor Text: After birth, its back swells and hardens into a shell. Powerfully sprays foam from its mouth.

Name: Wartortle
Pokedex Flavor Text: Often hides in water to stalk unwary prey. For swimming fast, it moves its ears to maintain balance.

Name: Blastoise
Pokedex Flavor Text: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

Name: Caterpie
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

Name: Metapod
Pokedex Flavor Text: This POKéMON is vulnerable to attack while its shell is soft, exposing its weak and tender body.

Name: Butterfree
Pokedex Flavor Text: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

Name: Weedle
Pokedex Flavor Text: Often found in forests, eating leaves. It has a sharp poisonous stinger on its head.

Name: Kakuna
Pokedex Flavor Text: Almost incapable of moving, this POKéMON can only harden its shell to protect itself.

Name: Beedrill
Pokedex Flavor Text: It flies at high speed and attacks using the large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

Name: Pidgey
Pokedex Flavor Text: A common sight in forests and woods. It flaps its wings at ground level to kick up blinding sand.

Name: Pidgeotto
Pokedex Flavor Text: Very protective of its sprawling territorial area, this POKéMON will fiercely peck at any intruder.

Name: Pidgeot
Pokedex Flavor Text: When hunting, it skims the surface of water at high speed to pick off unwary prey such as MAGIKARP.

Name: Rattata
Pokedex Flavor Text: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

Name: Raticate
Pokedex Flavor Text: It uses its whisker to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

Name: Spearow
Pokedex Flavor Text: Eats bugs in grassy areas. It has to flap its short wings at high speed to stay airborne.

Name: Fearow
Pokedex Flavor Text: With its huge and magnificent wings, it can keep aloft without ever having to land for rest.

Name: Ekans
Pokedex Flavor Text: Moves silently and stealthily. Eats the eggs of birds, such as PIDGEY and SPEAROW, whole.

Name: Arbok
Pokedex Flavor Text: It is rumored that the ferocious warning markings on its belly differ from area to area.

Name: Pikachu
Pokedex Flavor Text: When several of these POKéMON gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

Name: Raichu
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

Name: Sandshrew
Pokedex Flavor Text: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

Name: Sandslash
Pokedex Flavor Text: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled to attack or escape.

Name: Nidoran♀
Pokedex Flavor Text: Although small, its venomous barbs render this POKéMON dangerous. The female has smaller horns.

Name: Nidorina
Pokedex Flavor Text: The female's horn develops slowly. Prefers physical attacks such as clawing and biting.

Name: Nidoqueen
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its hard scales provide strong protection. It uses its hefty bulk to execute powerful moves.

Name: Nidoran♂
Pokedex Flavor Text: Stiffens its ears to rove for danger. The larger its horns, the more powerful its secreted venom.

Name: Nidorino
Pokedex Flavor Text: An aggressive POKéMON that is quick to attack. The horn on its head secretes a powerful venom.

Name: Nidoking
Pokedex Flavor Text: It uses its powerful tail in battle to smash, constrict, then break the prey's bones.

Name: Clefairy
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its magical and cute appeal has many admirers. It is rare and found only in certain areas.

Name: Clefable
Pokedex Flavor Text: A timid fairy POKéMON that is rarely seen. It will run and hide the moment it senses people.

Name: Vulpix
Pokedex Flavor Text: At the time of birth, it has only one tail. The tail divides from its tip as it grows older.

Name: Ninetales
Pokedex Flavor Text: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

Name: Jigglypuff
Pokedex Flavor Text: When its huge eyes light up, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls enemies to sleep.

Name: Wigglytuff
Pokedex Flavor Text: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

Name: Zubat
Pokedex Flavor Text: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

Name: Golbat
Pokedex Flavor Text: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

Name: Oddish
Pokedex Flavor Text: During the day, it keeps its face buried in the ground. At night, it wanders around sowing its seeds.

Name: Gloom
Pokedex Flavor Text: The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn't drool. It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

Name: Vileplume
Pokedex Flavor Text: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

Name: Paras
Weaknesses: Fire (4x), Flying (4x), Poison, Rock, Bug, Ice
Pokedex Flavor Text: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

Name: Parasect
Weaknesses: Fire (4x), Flying (4x), Poison, Rock, Bug, Ice
Pokedex Flavor Text: A host-parasite pair in which the parasite mushroom has taken over the host bug. Prefers damp places.

Name: Venonat
Pokedex Flavor Text: Lives in the shadows of tall trees where it eats insects. It is attracted by light at night.

Name: Venomoth
Pokedex Flavor Text: The dust-like scales covering its wings are color coded to indicate the kinds of poison it has.

Name: Diglett
Pokedex Flavor Text: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

Name: Dugtrio
Pokedex Flavor Text: A team of DIGLETT triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

Name: Meowth
Pokedex Flavor Text: Adores circular objects. Wanders the street on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

Name: Persian
Pokedex Flavor Text: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

Name: Psyduck
Pokedex Flavor Text: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily POKéMON will use psychokinetic powers.

Name: Golduck
Pokedex Flavor Text: Often seen swimming elegantly by lake shores. It is often mistaken for the Japanese monster, Kappa.

Name: Mankey
Pokedex Flavor Text: Extremely quick to anger. It could be docile one moment then thrashing away the next instant.

Name: Primeape
Evolution Level / Method: Level up using Rage Fist 20 times
Pokedex Flavor Text: Always furious and tenacious to boot. It will not abandon chasing its quarry until it is caught.

Name: Growlithe
Pokedex Flavor Text: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

Name: Arcanine
Pokedex Flavor Text: A POKéMON that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

Name: Poliwag
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.

Name: Poliwhirl
Evolution Level / Method: Water Stone or Trade with King's Rock
Pokedex Flavor Text: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

Name: Poliwrath
Pokedex Flavor Text: An adept swimmer at both the front crawl and breast stroke. Easily overtakes the best human swimmers.

Name: Abra
Pokedex Flavor Text: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and TELEPORT to safety.

Name: Kadabra
Pokedex Flavor Text: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

Name: Alakazam
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5,000.

Name: Machop
Pokedex Flavor Text: Loves to build its muscles. It trains in all styles of martial arts to become even stronger.

Name: Machoke
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power save belt to be able to regulate its motions.

Name: Machamp
Pokedex Flavor Text: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

Name: Bellsprout
Pokedex Flavor Text: A carnivorous POKéMON that traps and eats bugs. It uses its root feet to soak up needed moisture.

Name: Weepinbell
Pokedex Flavor Text: It spits out POISONPOWDER to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of ACID.

Name: Victreebel
Pokedex Flavor Text: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.

Name: Tentacool
Pokedex Flavor Text: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

Name: Tentacruel
Pokedex Flavor Text: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

Name: Geodude
Weaknesses: Water (4x), Grass (4x), Ice, Fighting, Ground, Steel
Pokedex Flavor Text: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step on or trip over them.

Name: Graveler
Weaknesses: Water (4x), Grass (4x), Ice, Fighting, Ground, Steel
Pokedex Flavor Text: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

Name: Golem
Weaknesses: Water (4x), Grass (4x), Ice, Fighting, Ground, Steel
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

Name: Ponyta
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

Name: Rapidash
Pokedex Flavor Text: Very competitive, this POKéMON will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

Name: Slowpoke
Evolution Level / Method: Level 37 or Trade with King's Rock
Pokedex Flavor Text: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

Name: Slowbro
Pokedex Flavor Text: An attached SHELLDER won't let go because of the tasty flavor that oozes out of its tail.

Name: Magnemite
Pokedex Flavor Text: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses THUNDER WAVE and similar moves.

Name: Magneton
Pokedex Flavor Text: Formed by several MAGNEMITEs linked together. They frequently appear when sunspots flare up.

Name: Farfetch'd
Pokedex Flavor Text: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

Name: Doduo
Pokedex Flavor Text: A bird that makes up for its poor flying with its fast foot speed. Leaves giant footprints.

Name: Dodrio
Pokedex Flavor Text: Uses its three brains to execute complex plans. While two heads sleep, one head stays awake.

Name: Seel
Pokedex Flavor Text: The protruding horn on its head is very hard. It is used for bashing through thick ice.

Name: Dewgong
Pokedex Flavor Text: Stores thermal energy in its body. Swims at a steady 8 knots even in intensely cold waters.

Name: Grimer
Pokedex Flavor Text: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

Name: Muk
Pokedex Flavor Text: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

Name: Shellder
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell opens.

Name: Cloyster
Pokedex Flavor Text: When attacked, it launches its horns in quick volleys. Its soft interior is never seen.

Name: Gastly
Pokedex Flavor Text: Almost invisible, this gaseous POKéMON cloaks the target and puts it to sleep without notice.

Name: Haunter
Pokedex Flavor Text: Because of its ability to slip through block walls, it is said to be from another dimension.

Name: Gengar
Pokedex Flavor Text: Under a full moon, this POKéMON likes to mimic the shadows of people and laugh at their fright.

Name: Onix
Weaknesses: Water (4x), Grass (4x), Ice, Fighting, Ground, Steel
Pokedex Flavor Text: As it grows, the stone portions of its body harden to become similar to a diamond, but colored black.

Name: Drowzee
Pokedex Flavor Text: Puts enemies to sleep then eats their dreams. Occasionally gets sick from eating bad dreams.

Name: Hypno
Pokedex Flavor Text: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of PSI moves such as HYPNOSIS and CONFUSION.

Name: Krabby
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its pincers are not only powerful weapons, they are used for balance when walking sideways.

Name: Kingler
Pokedex Flavor Text: The large pincer has 10,000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

Name: Voltorb
Pokedex Flavor Text: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé BALL, they have zapped many people.

Name: Electrode
Pokedex Flavor Text: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

Name: Exeggcute
Weaknesses: Bug (4x), Fire, Flying, Poison, Ice, Ghost, Dark
Pokedex Flavor Text: Often mistaken for eggs. When disturbed, they quickly gather and attack in swarms.

Name: Exeggutor
Weaknesses: Bug (4x), Fire, Flying, Poison, Ice, Ghost, Dark
Pokedex Flavor Text: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an EXEGGCUTE.

Name: Cubone
Pokedex Flavor Text: Because it never removes its skull helmet, no one has ever seen this POKéMON's real face.

Name: Marowak
Pokedex Flavor Text: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to KO targets.

Name: Hitmonlee
Pokedex Flavor Text: When in a hurry, its legs lengthen progressively. It runs smoothly with extra long, loping strides.

Name: Hitmonchan
Pokedex Flavor Text: While apparently doing nothing, it fires punches in lightning fast volleys that are impossible to see.

Name: Lickitung
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its tongue can be extended like a chameleon's. It leaves a stinging sensation when it licks enemies.

Name: Koffing
Pokedex Flavor Text: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.

Name: Weezing
Pokedex Flavor Text: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two KOFFINGs can fuse into a WEEZING over many years.

Name: Rhyhorn
Weaknesses: Water (4x), Grass (4x), Ice, Fighting, Ground, Steel
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its massive bones are 1000 times harder than human bone. It can easily knock a trailer flying.

Name: Rhydon
Weaknesses: Water (4x), Grass (4x), Ice, Fighting, Ground, Steel
Pokedex Flavor Text: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees.

Name: Chansey
Pokedex Flavor Text: A rare and elusive POKéMON that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to catch it.

Name: Tangela
Pokedex Flavor Text: The whole body is swathed with wide vines that are similar to seaweed. Its vines shake as it walks.

Name: Kangaskhan
Pokedex Flavor Text: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

Name: Horsea
Pokedex Flavor Text: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

Name: Seadra
Pokedex Flavor Text: Capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its wing-like pectoral fins and stout tail.

Name: Goldeen
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its tail fin billows like an elegant ballroom dress, giving it the nickname of the Water Queen.

Name: Seaking
Pokedex Flavor Text: In the autumn spawning season, they can be seen swimming powerfully up rivers and creeks.

Name: Staryu
Pokedex Flavor Text: An enigmatic POKéMON that can effortlessly regenerate any appendage it loses in battle.

Name: Starmie
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its central core glows with the seven colors of the rainbow. Some people value the core as a gem.

Name: Mr. Mime
Pokedex Flavor Text: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

Name: Scyther
Evolution Level / Method: Trade holding Metal Coat / Black Augurite
Pokedex Flavor Text: With ninja-like agility and speed, it can create the illusion that there is more than one.

Name: Jynx
Weaknesses: Fire, Bug, Rock, Ghost, Steel, Dark
Pokedex Flavor Text: It seductively wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.

Name: Electabuzz
Pokedex Flavor Text: Normally found near power plants, they can wander away and cause major blackouts in cities.

Name: Magmar
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its body always burns with an orange glow that enables it to hide perfectly among flames.

Name: Pinsir
Pokedex Flavor Text: If it fails to crush the victim in its pincers, it will swing it around and toss it hard.

Name: Tauros
Pokedex Flavor Text: When targeting an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

Name: Magikarp
Pokedex Flavor Text: In the distant past, it was somewhat stronger than the horribly weak descendants that exist today.

Name: Gyarados
Pokedex Flavor Text: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.

Name: Lapras
Pokedex Flavor Text: A POKéMON that has been overhunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

Name: Ditto
Pokedex Flavor Text: Capable of copying an enemy's genetic code to instantly transform itself into a duplicate of the enemy.

Name: Eevee
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

Name: Vaporeon
Pokedex Flavor Text: Lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

Name: Jolteon
Pokedex Flavor Text: It accumulates negative ions in the atmosphere to blast out 10,000-volt lightning bolts.

Name: Flareon
Pokedex Flavor Text: When storing thermal energy in its body, its temperature could soar to over 1,600 degrees.

Name: Porygon
Pokedex Flavor Text: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

Name: Omanyte
Pokedex Flavor Text: Although long extinct, in rare cases, it can be genetically regenerated from fossils.

Name: Omastar
Pokedex Flavor Text: A prehistoric POKéMON that died out when its heavy shell made it impossible to catch prey.

Name: Kabuto
Pokedex Flavor Text: A POKéMON that was resurrected from a fossil found in what was once the ocean floor eons ago.

Name: Kabutops
Pokedex Flavor Text: Its sleek shape is perfect for swimming. It slashes prey with its claws and drains the body fluids.

Name: Aerodactyl
Pokedex Flavor Text: A ferocious, prehistoric POKéMON that goes for the enemy's throat with its serrated saw-like fangs.

Name: Snorlax
Pokedex Flavor Text: Very lazy. Just eats and sleeps. As its rotund bulk builds, it becomes steadily more slothful.

Name: Articuno
Pokedex Flavor Text: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

Name: Zapdos
Pokedex Flavor Text: A legendary bird POKéMON that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

Name: Moltres
Pokedex Flavor Text: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

Name: Dratini
Pokedex Flavor Text: Long considered a mythical POKéMON until recently when a small colony was found living underwater.

Name: Dragonair
Pokedex Flavor Text: A mystical POKéMON that exudes a gentle aura. Has the ability to change climate conditions.

Name: Dragonite
Pokedex Flavor Text: An extremely rarely seen marine POKéMON. Its intelligence is said to match that of humans.

Name: Mewtwo
Pokedex Flavor Text: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

Name: Mew
Pokedex Flavor Text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.
